subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Algorithm Knows You
description: A quick, practical guide to The Algorithm Knows You.

hook.text: Netflix doesn't guess what you want to watch. It already knows, based on millions of data points about your behavior.

buildup.text: Every pause, rewind, and abandoned show is tracked. The algorithm learns your taste better than you know it yourself.

discovery.text: Netflix even tests different thumbnail images. You and your neighbor might see different art for the same movie.

twist.text: The algorithm creates filter bubbles. You only see what the system thinks you'll like, narrowing your world.

climax.text: Recommendation engines now drive 80 percent of what people watch on Netflix. Discovery is algorithmic, not human.

punchline.text: You think you chose that show. The algorithm chose it for you.

quiz.question: What percentage of Netflix viewing is driven by its recommendation algorithm?
